items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Danny Polo was playing lead clarinet and lead alto. ... I played his book

ctx.x: There were seven reeds so the conventional numbering of the chairs doesn’t work for that band. What chair were you playing?
That was five saxes. I was playing third. Danny Polo was playing lead clarinet and lead alto.
I wanted to ask you about Danny Polo. You sat next to him, right?
